summary: Iteration 52 e2e: support alerts, canned replies, Journal newsletter (subscribe/send/unsubscribe) and the logo on PDFs + printable invoice. Backend: 24 pytest tests pass, 1 skipped (empty-subscriber-list refusal could not be asserted while subscribers existed). Frontend: newsletter block on /blog and article pages, duplicate + invalid email handling, /unsubscribe valid & bad token, admin saved-replies CRUD + placeholder substitution, admin Journal subscriber count / send-to-subscribers / draft-has-no-button / create+delete, SEO panel, printable invoice logo, and 390px checks — all pass. PDF logo verified by rendering page 1 with pymupdf for order invoice, pass, commission invoice and a freshly generated vendor agreement: brand mark top-left, no overlap with the right-hand receipt/invoice number, body content unchanged.

minor.issue: Existing agreements are served from the immutable stored copy in db.agreement_documents, which was generated before the logo change, so all 4 seeded agreements download WITHOUT the logo. Freshly generated agreement PDFs do carry it (verified by calling agreements.agreement_pdf directly). Confirm this is intended (hash-signed documents must not change) — if the logo is wanted on existing agreements the stored copies need regenerating on the next version bump.

Pre-existing: the INR rupee sign renders as a black tofu box in the amount column (Helvetica has no ₹ glyph) — see /app/test_reports/pytest/i52_order_invoice.png. The commission invoice avoids this by printing 'INR 704.00'. Not caused by this increment.

422 body is the raw pydantic message, so the UI toast reads 'value is not a valid email address: The part after the @-sign is not valid...'. Functionally correct, but a friendlier copy line would match the rest of the product.

action_items: Decide whether stored (pre-logo) vendor agreement PDFs should be regenerated so downloads of existing agreements also show the brand mark — new generations already do.
Optional: register a font with the ₹ glyph (or print 'INR') in invoices.py so order invoice/receipt amounts stop rendering a black box for INR.
Optional: map the 422 email-validation detail to a friendly message on the newsletter form.
critical_code_review_comments: notify_support_staff loops staff serially and awaits send_email inline inside POST /api/support/threads; with many admins the visitor-facing request latency grows linearly (each Resend call is a network round trip). Consider fire-and-forget / background task.
admin_blog_newsletter sends to up to 5000 subscribers inside the HTTP request with a per-recipient await — this will time out at scale; batch it or move to a background job.
server.py is 9505 lines; the newsletter, support-alert and canned-reply blocks are self-contained and would be better as their own modules (matches existing invoices.py/passes.py pattern).

newsletter_subscribe silently returns the friendly 'already on the list' message for an existing active subscriber but resubscribing an unsubscribed address reuses the old token — good; just note the old token stays valid forever with no rotation.
seed_data_creation: Created and then removed: TEST_ newsletter subscribers, TEST guest/member support threads, a TEST_pw canned reply, a TEST_pw draft Journal post. Ran /app/backend/tests/i52_cleanup.py — 15 subs, 12 threads, 12 support notifications deleted, newsletter_sent_at/newsletter_sent_count unset on the 1 story that was emailed. 0 active subscribers left; only the pre-existing 'Refund timeline' canned reply remains.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md — admin@buddilio.com / Admin@123 worked; member arjun.sethi@example.com / User@12345 worked; partner@buddilio.com / Partner@123 worked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login route is /login (NOT /auth). Admin sections via data-testid=admin-tab-{support,blog,seo...}. Emails: Resend BLOCKS admin@buddilio.com (422, logged by buddilio.email, API still returns 200) but ACCEPTS *@example.com — so 'Send to subscribers' really reported 'Sent to 2' and set the sent badge; the zero-sent branch (newsletter_sent_at left empty, resend allowed) is only reachable when every recipient is rejected. Support alert notifications are titled '<name> wants a human' / '<name> replied in support', type 'support'. Canned-reply substitution happens client-side in SupportInbox.fill(); {my_name} resolves to 'Buddilio' because admin full_name is 'Buddilio Admin'. PDF checks use pymupdf page.get_image_info() + rendered PNGs in /app/test_reports/pytest/i52_*.png. Vendor agreement PDFs are served from db.agreement_documents when a stored copy exists.
rca_of_the_issue: Missing logo on the vendor-agreement download traces to vendor_routes.agreement_pdf_download preferring db.agreement_documents (executed/immutable copy stored at acceptance time, before pdfbrand.logo() was added) over regenerating; the generator itself renders the logo correctly. Two initial test failures were test-side only: a newsletter active-count delta assertion that raced with a parallel xdist worker, and a mongo lookup using the mixed-case email while the API stores it lowercased — both fixed in the test file.
